text_block_list.text: —A few days after that Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Trainer. I've made up my mind.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Let's meet again in an hour. I'll text the 
meeting spot to your phone.
(――*chime♪*)

The smartphone screen lit up. The location 
displayed there was—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Here you are, Trainer. Are you prepared?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The resolve to walk a path fit for a King, 
a truly first-rate journey true to who I 
am.

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Is that girl running today? Then 
why is she in a place like this...

text_block_list.name: Gossiping Race Fan
text_block_list.text:
Huh, no way! Isn't that girl the rich lady 
who ran in the Kikuka Sho?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're right. Huh...? Wait... Was 
there an entry announcement today...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, a crowd of spectators is gathering. 
Though this is still just the baiting 
phase.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: What we should aim for is—

text_block_list.name: Magazine Journalist
text_block_list.text:
Hey, is it true that she's here!? That 
young lady—

text_block_list.name: Paparazzo
text_block_list.text:
“—Found you! Hehe, I'll be the first to 
reveal that side of you!”

text_block_list.name: Paparazzo
text_block_list.text:
"The Young Lady Goes Wild in Her Racing 
Racewear!?" Combined with the latest scoop 
on her mother, this'll make killer 
material...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! You've arrived, esteemed members 
of the media!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Shall we begin, Trainer? Time for the 
"media greeting."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, don't play dumb. You know it too, 
don't you?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, surprised? This is my brand new 
call! King's "Media Greeting"!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
So you better remember it too! When they 
ask 'Who is she?', you shout 'King!' got 
it?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Come on, we have no time. We're going in 
without a rehearsal!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: My name is—?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Wiser than anyone else?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...And an intelligent Umamusume! Which 
means, naturally...?"
choice_data_list:
First-rate, just as everyone aspires to 
be!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Which means! The Umamusume most 
worthy of standing at the peak of this 
world is...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Faster than anyone! Stronger than anyone! 
The name of the first-class Umamusume 
forging her own path is—"
(Murmur...!?)

text_block_list.name: Magazine Journalist
text_block_list.text:
Wh... What's this...? An 
out-of-the-blue... s-self-introduction?

text_block_list.name: Paparazzo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Isn't that great, isn't that 
wonderful! I just love that kind of 
entertainment!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
To all members of the media gathered here! 
I'll be so generous as to reveal King's 
next goal!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Next up—I'm taking 1st in the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen!!

text_block_list.name: Magazine Journalist
text_block_list.text:
Takamatsunomiya!? That's a sprint! What 
about the classic path we've built up 
until now!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
A sudden change in direction... Huh! The 
daytime talk shows could really run with 
this scoop!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, please don't compare this to an 
ordinary change in course. This was my 
path from the very beginning.

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
However, don't you... and your mother's 
fans, wish for that as well...?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... Mother's fans have nothing to do 
with this. I'll walk my own path, with my 
own fans.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The past is the past, the present is the 
present. I simply discard all unnecessary 
background.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I will obtain a strength that belongs to 
me alone. That should be more than enough, 
right?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Because I am first-rate! And I am the 
Umamusume who will surpass all to become 
ultra-first-rate!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text: Top-notch...?

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Then! Please tell us the deciding factor 
behind choosing the Takamatsunomiya Kinen 
as well!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
To herald the arrival of spring before the 
Tenno Sho (Spring). ...How does that sound 
to you?

text_block_list.name: Magazine Journalist
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh...? Wh-What's that about...? Don't 
tell me that capricious young lady is—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, still curious about me? Then feel 
free to interview me all you like!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I shall grant you the right to interview 
me! Ohohoho!

Before the agitated and excited press 
corps, King Halo made a powerful 
declaration.

From here on, she heads down a new path of 
her own making, one distinct from 
tradition. Accompanied by hearty, booming 
laughter.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer. With that settled, 
could you switch me to the sprint menu 
right away?
choice_data_list:
You're surprisingly diligent about that, 
huh.

You're quite reliable when it comes to 
that, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Of course I am. After making a 
declaration like that, I'm fully prepared 
to drag myself through the mud if I have 
to.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Having finished the Triple Crown route 
walked until now, the path ahead 
represents a complete, near-opposite shift 
in direction.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
And despite that sudden change of course, 
she's about to stand on the grand stage of 
a GⅠ.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You'll probably hear a lot of opinions. 
You might even be compared to Special 
Week-san and the others who are meeting 
everyone's expectations.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
“Even so, I'm certainly not one to give up 
before I've even tried.”

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep putting in the effort, so that I 
can walk my own path.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"I don't care if it's unrefined. In the 
end, I'll be the one laughing as the 
victor."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yes! Let's do this!

—Her next aim was the 'Takamatsunomiya 
Kinen'. As she ran, her stride appeared 
more resolute and powerful than ever 
before.
